title: Chunk a corpus and defend the choice

exports.name: chunk_fixed
exports.signature: chunk_fixed(text: str, size: int, overlap: int) -> list[tuple[int, int]]
exports.description: Split text into fixed-length chunks with the given overlap, returned as start and end offsets.

exports.name: token_recall
exports.signature: token_recall(retrieved: list[tuple[int, int]], relevant: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> float
exports.description: Fraction of the relevant token positions covered by the retrieved spans.

exports.name: token_iou
exports.signature: token_iou(retrieved: list[tuple[int, int]], relevant: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> float
exports.description: Intersection over union of retrieved and relevant token positions, which penalises retrieving more than was needed.

exports.name: sweep
exports.signature: sweep(text: str, sizes: list[int], overlaps: list[int], queries: list[dict]) -> list[dict]
exports.description: Score every size and overlap combination over the query set and return one record per combination.
